name: refund-window
behaviour: A refund inside the refund window is issued once, and one outside it is refused with no refund made.
derivedFrom: owned fixture suite: PROMISE-01 (no refund promised outside the refund window) and PROMISE-04 (an eligible refund is promised and recorded)

actor.description: The actor asking for the refunds (it owns both orders).

recentPath.description: The refund route of an order inside the window (POST).

stalePath.description: The refund route of an order outside the window (POST).

effectSource.description: The observer source that records the action's effect (http-egress: a payment call on the request path).

effectOperation.description: The operation that source records for the effect (send for an outbound call, insert for an audit row).

effectName.description: The effect's exact name: the destination host for http-egress, the action for an audit table.

resourcePrefix.description: The resource prefix every effect of this action carries (such as POST /v1/refunds/ for http-egress): the twin shows it selects, and the refusal must make none.

successStatus.description: The status of an issued refund.

refusalStatuses.description: The statuses that count as a refusal.
